violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager (CFM) who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: EUHOMY ICE MACHINE DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE NSF OR ANSI EQUIVALENT.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. PLEASE PROVIDE NSF OR ANSI EQUIVALENT EQUIPMENT OR SUBMIT SPECIFICATIONS VERIFYING CURRENT EQUIPMENT MEETS THE APPROVED REQUIREMENTS.
